name: Banh goi Nam Dinh
summary: Bánh gối Nam Định is a fried cake with a Hoa lineage, and Thế giới tiếp thị says it is not the Hanoi bánh gối. The wrapper is rice paper brushed with wheat flour. The filling is pork, wood-ear, quail egg, and glass noodles. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Nam Định. Thế giới tiếp thị, 12 September 2022. Dân Việt on 5 September 2025 places it on Nguyễn Văn Trỗi and Hoàng Văn Thụ.
texture: Fried as soon as it is wrapped, turned so both sides color. Eaten at once, it is fragrant and crisp, and Thế giới tiếp thị says it is not greasy.
howToEat: Straight from the pan, with sour-sweet fish sauce, chili, garlic, herbs, and dưa góp. A clock was not printed. Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Nguyễn Văn Trỗi and Hoàng Văn Thụ. A door was not printed. Check on arrival.
